description_en: Translates text for content creation using AMB
kebab_example: aliyun aimiaobi run-translate-generation --workspace-id llm-xxx --reference-data '{"Contents":["xxx"]}' --task-id xxx --prompt English --region cn-hangzhou
name: RunTranslateGeneration

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the Alibaba Cloud Model Studio workspace. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2782167.html
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云百炼业务空间唯一标识：获取https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2782167.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en:
Optional. The unique ID of the associated creative article.

You do not need to specify TaskId. The system generates one automatically. If subsequent tasks use the same TaskId, they belong to the same conversation group
parameters.help_zh:
非必填，关联创作文章唯一标识
TaskId默认无需填写，系统将自动生成。当后续任务填写的TaskId相同时，表示这些任务属于同一组对话
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en:
The target language for translation. The source language is automatically detected.

| Language           | Prompt value |
| ------------------ | ------------ |
| English            | English      |
| Simplified Chinese | Chinese      |
| Japanese           | Japanese     |
| Korean             | Korean       |
| Spanish            | Spanish      |
| French             | French       |
| Portuguese         | Portuguese   |
| German             | German       |
| Italian            | Italian      |
parameters.help_zh:

| 简体中文 | Chinese |
| 日语 | Japanese |
| 韩语 | Korean |

parameters.name: prompt
